mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS>0.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 0.5% and inflation is accelerating (CPIAUCSL > 235.5), the market expects a policy response that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails to materialize in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (UNRATE > 5.5), the market expects a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong supply-side activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 900 and retail sales (RSAFS) are above 430000, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails to materialize in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
